messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to meet with me today. I’d like to start by asking about the overall goals you have for enhancing the student portal. What do you hope to achieve with the new features?

Hi! Thanks for having me. So, honestly, I just want the portal to be a lot easier to use. Like, my timetable is a bit of a mess right now, and it would be great if I could make it look how I want. Also, I really want to get notifications when my grades come out — it feels like I always have to check manually. And, it would be nice to have a way to give feedback on my modules, you know? Just stuff like that.

That makes sense! So, to clarify, you want to enhance the portal to make it easier to use, especially regarding the timetable, notifications for grades, and a feedback system for modules. Could you tell me a bit more about how you envision the personalised timetable management? What specific changes would you like to see?

Yeah, so, for the timetable, I just think it should be more customizable. Like, I’d love to colour-code my modules so I can see them at a glance, and it would be great if I could hide any classes that are cancelled. Sometimes, I just want to block out time for my own study sessions too. Basically, just make it easier to read and plan my time.

Got it! So for the personalised timetable, you’d like to have features like colour-coding for modules, the ability to hide cancelled classes, and the option to block out time for your own study sessions. That sounds really helpful! 

Now, about the automated grade notifications you mentioned, could you explain how you would like those notifications to work? What kind of updates do you want to receive?

Sure! I just want to get a notification whenever a new grade is posted for any of my modules. Like, I don’t want to have to keep checking all the time. Just a quick alert to let me know something's been updated would be awesome. It could be via email or whatever, just something to keep me in the loop, you know?

Thanks for that clarification! So, you want to receive notifications whenever a new grade is posted for any of your modules, and it could be through email or another method, just to keep you updated without having to check manually. 

Now, regarding the structured module feedback system, what kind of feedback would you like to provide? Can you give me an example of what you’d want to share about a module?

Yeah, so, I think it would be helpful to give feedback on stuff like the quality of the content and how well the module was taught. Like, if a lecture was really engaging or if the resources were useful. Just things that could help the lecturers improve. I’d want to share my thoughts after the teaching period ends, so it’s fresh in my mind. It's just nice to have a way to express how I felt about the module, you know?

That sounds great! So for the structured module feedback system, you'd like to provide feedback on things like the quality of content, teaching effectiveness, and the usefulness of resources, preferably after the teaching period ends. This would help lecturers improve their courses. 

Just to recap, here are the requirements we've discussed so far: 

1. Personalised timetable management with features like colour-coding, hiding cancelled classes, and blocking out time for study sessions.
2. Automated grade notifications that alert you whenever a new grade is posted, possibly via email.
3. A structured module feedback system that allows you to provide feedback on content quality, teaching effectiveness, and resources after the teaching period.

Are there any limitations or restrictions we should keep in mind for these enhancements?

Um, I haven't really thought about any limitations. I just want things to be easier and more useful. I guess it should all work with what we already have without needing extra accounts or anything, but I’m not sure about any technical stuff or rules. I just care about making it better for students.

That’s a helpful insight! So, just to confirm, you want the enhancements to work seamlessly with the existing portal infrastructure without needing extra accounts or anything complicated. 

I think I have enough clear requirements now. Here’s what we have:

1. Personalised timetable management with features like colour-coding, hiding cancelled classes, and blocking out time for study sessions.
2. Automated grade notifications that alert you whenever a new grade is posted, possibly via email.
3. A structured module feedback system that allows you to provide feedback on content quality, teaching effectiveness, and resources after the teaching period.
4. Enhancements should integrate with the existing portal infrastructure without requiring extra accounts.

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
